description: The bundled main window ships the internal-alpha product surface: transcript-alpha capture commands, retained-meeting Library with its standing retention overview, exact transcript/title search, content-free voice-profile status, the guided enrolment surface (sitting recorder, measured operating-point review, and profile build/publication, encoder-admitted builds only), explicit preserve-first legacy-profile migration, separately confirmed profile reset, the reviewed one-meeting audio-deletion boundary, the separately reviewed whole-meeting deletion boundary, and the frozen withheld-turn restoration. It can report and request the two capture permissions for first run through the manifest-verified permission probe, which holds no storage authority and reads no operator content. It has no note generation, generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, or remote-origin permission.
